compiler.root_cause: The existing V18 megamenu browser contract verified readability on the homepage only. Page-specific computed layout drift on routes such as /wijzigingen could therefore narrow and offset the same menu without failing the release gate.

historical_replay: 2026-09-22 screenshots showed /wijzigingen with a much narrower Meer panel than the accepted wide menu on another public page.
Existing v18-megamenu-browser-check used only baseUrl and therefore could not detect cross-route geometry drift.

prevention.prevention_rule: Treat the desktop Meer panel as one canonical viewport-centered component and verify representative public routes against the homepage for identical navigation labels, width and left edge.
regression_contract: route geometry may differ by no more than 2px at the same viewport

evidence.outcome: Candidate build and static regression checks must pass before promotion; the same multi-route browser contract is reused by production readback.
